The inscription says "DĘBNO-KOŚCIÓŁEK XVw", the little 15th-century church in Dębno.

paragraphs.en: The church of St. Michael the Archangel was built in the second half of the 15th century, in the place of an older church. It is a log building of larch and fir, put together without nails and held by wooden pegs. The nave is only 7 by 8.3 metres. The tower, 15 metres high and built as a timber frame, was added in 1601. Since 2003 the church has been on the UNESCO World Heritage list, as one of the wooden churches of southern Małopolska.

paragraphs.en: The Polish post issued the stamp on 21 November 1977. It belongs to a set of six called "Zabytki architektury", monuments of architecture. The other five show the Wolin Gate in Kamień Pomorski, the monastery in Przasnysz, the cathedral in Płock, Kórnik Castle and Wilanów Palace.

paragraphs.en: The paintings date from around 1500. They were made with stencils, and the Medieval Heritage website describes them as the oldest fully preserved paintings of this kind. Look for the deer among the animals. In the main altar stands a triptych from the early 16th century with the Madonna, St. Michael with his scales and sword, and St. Catherine. The crucifix is from about 1380, and the church also keeps a painted Gothic tabernacle from the 14th century and a statue of St. Nicholas from 1420.

Poszukaj jelenia wśród zwierząt. W ołtarzu głównym stoi tryptyk z początku XVI wieku z Madonną, św. Michałem z wagą i mieczem oraz św. Katarzyną. Krucyfiks pochodzi z około 1380 roku, a w kościele zachowały się też malowane gotyckie tabernakulum z XIV wieku i figura św. Mikołaja z 1420 roku.

paragraphs.en: From Dębno the Velo Dunajec cycle path follows the south shore of Lake Czorsztyn to Niedzica, about 15 kilometres. On the way you see the ruins of Czorsztyn Castle, and Niedzica Castle is in the village at the end of the path. From Niedzica it is about 15 kilometres further to Sromowce Wyżne-Kąty, where the rafting trips on the Dunajec start.
